+++ b/minbpe/regex.py
@@ -99,19 +99,34 @@
-            p0, p1 = pair
-            touched = []
-            where_idx = where[idx]
-            for k in where[p0] & where[p1]:
-                old = ids[k]
-                new = merge(old, pair, idx)
-                if len(new) == len(old):
-                    continue
-                ids[k] = new
-                w = weights[k]
-                for p in zip(old, old[1:]):
-                    stats[p] -= w
-                    touched.append(p)
-                for p in zip(new, new[1:]):
-                    stats[p] = stats_get(p, 0) + w
-                where_idx.add(k)
-            for p in touched:
-                if stats_get(p) == 0:
-                    del stats[p]
+            # (pair count changes are accumulated per distinct pair first, in C
+            # for the common weight-1 chunks, then applied once; the final
+            # counts are the same, and stats order does not matter: ties are
+            # broken by scanning ids above)
+            p0, p1 = pair
+            dec = {}
+            inc = {}
+            dec_get = dec.get
+            inc_get = inc.get
+            where_idx = where[idx]
+            for k in where[p0] & where[p1]:
+                old = ids[k]
+                new = merge(old, pair, idx)
+                if len(new) == len(old):
+                    continue
+                ids[k] = new
+                w = weights[k]
+                if w == 1:
+                    _count_elements(dec, zip(old, old[1:]))
+                    _count_elements(inc, zip(new, new[1:]))
+                else:
+                    for p in zip(old, old[1:]):
+                        dec[p] = dec_get(p, 0) + w
+                    for p in zip(new, new[1:]):
+                        inc[p] = inc_get(p, 0) + w
+                where_idx.add(k)
+            for p, c in inc.items():
+                stats[p] = stats_get(p, 0) + c
+            for p, c in dec.items():
+                c = stats[p] - c
+                if c:
+                    stats[p] = c
+                else:
+                    del stats[p]
